# Global bootstrap oracle

`oracle.csv` is the output of `oracle.cpp` against QuantLib 1.43 at
`9863b578af0caa4cecabf697196533e84a8308b6`. It independently solves a deposit,
a futures convexity quote, an extra deposit residual, and an additional node.
Both rows include a full recalibration after the additional market quote changes.
Python checks discounts, fitted convexity, and helper residuals at the existing
curve-consistency tolerance, `1e-9`; expected values are never generated by Rust.

The fixture follows the unregistered convexity-handle requirement in
`testGlobalBootstrapVariables` (`test-suite/piecewiseyieldcurve.cpp`).

Run from this fixture directory; `QL` is the built QuantLib source checkout and
`BOOST_INCLUDE` is the Boost header directory (for example, `/opt/homebrew/include`).

```sh
c++ -std=c++17 -I "$QL/build" -I "$QL" -I "$BOOST_INCLUDE" \
  oracle.cpp -L "$QL/build/ql" -lQuantLib \
  -Wl,-rpath,"$QL/build/ql" -o /tmp/global-bootstrap-oracle
/tmp/global-bootstrap-oracle > oracle.csv
```
